name: cloud_cogs_analysis
description: Cloud COGS and gross margin analysis. Breaks down cloud infrastructure cost of goods sold by cloud provider, product or feature, and cost category (compute, storage, data transfer, AI/GPU). Surfaces gross margin trends, unit economics (cost per consumption unit, cost per TB), committed-spend and discount impact, actuals vs forecast, and a period-over-period margin bridge. Triggers: COGS, cloud COGS, gross margin, cost of goods, cloud cost, compute cost, storage cost, cost per unit, cost per TB, unit economics, infrastructure cost, margin trend, what is driving COGS, margin compression, margin expansion, cloud billing, cost breakdown, net vs list cost, committed spend, enterprise discount, savings plan, reserved instance, commitment, GPU cost, AI cost, actual vs forecast COGS, month-to-date pace, provider mix.
